operations.description: You can use this API to get the current Available to Sell inventory quantities for all WFS items in your catalog. You can also query specific SKUs or filter to only items updated after a specific date in order to reduce the response size.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] wfs inventory [PATH] v 3 fulfillment inventory [PARAMS] access channel consumer correlation date from id limit modified name offset qos sec sku svc to token type wm [SCHEMA]

operations.description: This API will retrieve the inventory count for all of a seller's items across all ship nodes by item to ship node mapping. Inventory can be zero or non-zero. Please note that NextCursor value changes and it needs to be passed on from the previous call to next call.
operations.summary: Multiple Item Inventory for All Ship Nodes
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] multi node inventory for all sku and all ship nodes [PATH] v 3 inventories [PARAMS] access channel consumer correlation cursor id limit name next qos sec svc token type wm [SCHEMA]

operations.description: This API will retrieve the inventory count for an item across all ship nodes or one specific ship node. You can specify the ship node for which you want to fetch the inventory
operations.summary: Single Item Inventory by Ship Node
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] multi node inventory for sku and all shipnodes [PATH] v 3 inventories [PARAMS] access channel consumer correlation id name node qos sec ship sku svc token type wm [SCHEMA]

operations.description: You can use this API to get the inventory for a given item.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] inventory [PATH] v 3 inventory [PARAMS] access channel consumer correlation id name node qos sec ship sku svc token type wm [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Updates inventory for items in bulk. Seller Can either use feed type "inventory" or "MP_INVENTORY" * Inventory spec 1.4 feed type: inventory * Inventory spec 1.5 feed type: MP_INVENTORY Please Note: Multi Node Inventory Update Feed (feedType=MP_INVENTORY) only supports JSON Request and Responses. Refer to "MultiNode_Bulk_Inventory_Update_Request.json" for the corresponding request sample Refer to the guide section for more detailed guide around each of the feed types Refer to the throttling limits before uploading the Feed Files.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] update bulk inventory [PATH] v 3 feeds [PARAMS] access channel consumer correlation feed id name node qos sec ship svc token type wm [SCHEMA]

operations.description: This API will update the inventory for an item across one or more fulfillment centers, known as ship nodes.
operations.summary: Update Item Inventory per Ship Node
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] update multi node inventory [PATH] v 3 inventories [PARAMS] access channel consumer correlation id name qos sec sku svc token type wm [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Updates the inventory for a given item.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] update inventory for an item [PATH] v 3 inventory [PARAMS] access channel consumer correlation id name node qos sec ship sku svc token type wm [SCHEMA]
